name: Yume no Ukihashi ~Shinshaku Genji Monogatari~ Wakamurasaki Yuugao Suetsumuhana Hen
original_name: 夢の浮橋～新釈源氏物語～ 若紫・夕顔・末摘花編
source:
This game is an eroge based on "The Tale of Genji."
It keeps the original story's depth and diverse characters but has been updated to appeal to  modern audiences. 
The protagonist, Hikaru Genji, is born as a prince of the Heian Emperor.
With his handsome looks and many a talent, he thrives in the aristocratic society of his time, having love affairs with various women—this is the essence of the story.
In this work, authors added deeper and funnier interpretations to those romantic encounters. 

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ061293.html/]dlsite[/url]]
